source_title: Phantom Blade Zero: Festering Secret Quest Walkthrough - GameRant
source_excerpt:
Festering Secret is one of the early side quests (Tales) that players will encounter in the Weeping Creek Valley region of Phantom Blade Zero . Players will need to start by entering the chain-sealed courtyard by acquiring the Dead Axe Phantom Edge, and will later need to deliver the captain's orders to his lieutenant at the Sha-Chi Tower outskirts.
How to Start the Festering Secret Quest in Phantom Blade Zero
Players will start the "Festering Secret" quest in Phantom Blade Zero right after reaching the Outpost bell in Weeping Creek Valley .
You'll need to interact with the chain-sealed gate with two guards positioned in front of it . Soul will comment on how this chain-sealed gate could be hiding secrets, and the quest will start. However, to enter the chain-sealed courtyard, you'll need to obtain the Dread Axe Phantom Edge first.
How to Open the Chain-Sealed Courtyard (Dread Axe Phantom Edge)
To get the Dread Axe Phantom Edge in Phantom Blade Zero , you'll need to keep heading west through the outpost until you reach a clearing where you'll encounter Axemaster Peng Meng's boss .
After defeating the boss, you'll get the Dread Axe Phantom Edge and the Four Fierce Axes quest document .
Now use the Dread Axe at the chain-sealed gate to break it and enter the courtyard.
How to Uncover the Truth of How Mandate Disciples Became Maskwalkers
Once you get through the gate of the chain-sealed courtyard, you'll need to defeat two Mandate Maskwalker enemies . One will be out in the open, while another one is inside the house to the right.
Once the enemies are taken care of, speak to one of the guards that rushed in to fight alongside Soul. They'll ask you to talk to the captain to learn more about these Maskwalker enemies.
How to Confront the Captain About Suspected Transcension
You'll need to talk to the Captain, the guy sitting on the tree branch at the entrance to the Weeping Creek Valley Outpost. After talking to the Captain, he'll hand you a document that you'll need to deliver to his lieutenant at the Sha-Chi Tower outskirts. After that, you'll need to progress the story normally.
How to Deliver the Captain's Orders to the Lieutenant at Sha-Chi Tower Outskirts
The Mandate Lieutenant at the Sha-Chi Tower outskirts can be found at the location I've marked above, near the Long Pillar Overlook bell. This area will be locked, and you'll need to complete the following objectives to reach it.
Obtain the Hunter’ Chain Sickle Phantom Edge by defeating The Hunt, Hunter of the Order boss.
Head back to Sha-Chi Tower's summit and retrieve the Sha-Chi Tower base Camp Gate Key .
Open the gate to "Sha-Chi Tower base Camp" and head inside.
Once you're inside the Sha-Chi Tower base camp, head to my location marker and use the metal pipe to reach the shack on the upper platform.
Inside, you'll find the Mandate Lieutenant, to whom you can hand over the Captain's Order. The lieutenant will hand over Gu Lingran's secret letter to Soul and ask him to take it to the captain. Now, all you need to do is fast travel back to the outpost and hand the secret letter to the Captain to complete the Festering Secret quest in Phantom Blade Zero .
